verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of commenting on designs, @-mentioning teammates, or resolving comment threads. The only reference to comments is a webhook event example ("a comment has been added"). That is evidence for the outbound-webhooks story and does not show in-file comment, mention, or resolve workflows. Commenting is a fair axis for a collaborative design tool, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can comment directly on designs, mention teammates, and resolve threads so review happens in the file, not in email
